name: World History and Concept — The Clockspring Sundering
core_rationale: Giant Primordial Artisans shattered during the Clockspring War, leaving behind a continent-sized nursery of living relics where 90 to 120 centimeter Star-Kindled children awaken to mend the broken world-mechanisms.

character_scale_law.head_to_body_ratio: 1:2.3 cute toddler and kid proportions with chunky boots, clear silhouettes, and expressive oversized backpacks and lanterns
silhouette_rules: Headgear, ears, and backpack props must read clearly at 12 meter camera distance against ground terrain.
Ground foliage never exceeds knee height (0.35 meters) in traversal lanes; bushes never exceed chest height (0.65 meters).

player_arrival_premise.player_identity: Star-Kindled Sprouts — 90 to 120 centimeter spirit-children condensed from fallen Hearth-Sparks.
player_arrival_premise.why_enter_world: Only small, nimble hands can crawl inside the fractured Titan Reliquaries and relight the World-Lanterns without triggering giant-scale defense wards.
player_arrival_premise.inciting_phenomenon: The Great Lantern Eclipse — outer continents are freezing into Fog of Lore, drawing newly condensed Sprouts into the warm Hearthbloom Basin.

primordial_gods.name: Sola, the Hearth-Weaver
primordial_gods.domain: Warmth, ceramic pottery, eternal embers, and shelter
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Provides a safe, warm, low-altitude cradle for new players to spawn and learn basic mechanics.
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: Fell curled around the central inland sea, baking the surrounding clay basin into permanently warm, fertile terraced meadows.
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Rounded kiln-baked cottage domes, low 0.60 meter hearth-counters, and lantern-lined cobblestone lanes.

primordial_gods.name: Krono, the Brass Titan
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Justifies mid-level mechanical biomes, wind-trains, and airship transit between continents.
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: His shattered gearbox ribs jut out across the eastern plateau, creating perpetual gale-force wind canyons.
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Brass wind-vane towers, cog-wheel elevators with 0.15 meter toddler step-risers, and copper viaducts.

primordial_gods.name: Vesper, the Dream-Eater
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Anchors the late-game northern anomaly and explains why the northern sea floats upward into storm clouds.
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: Cracked the planetary crust into inverted floating islands shrouded in violet static.
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Inverted basalt spires and weightless tether-bridges.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Sailors swear compasses spin backward north of the Brass Strait, pointing up at the clouds instead of the horizon.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A ring of levitating black monoliths suspended inside a permanent aurora borealis.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Is Vesper dead like the other Primordial Gods, or dreaming inside the floating core?
mystery_hook.discovery_trigger_hint: Unlocked after restoring Krono's Great Mainspring in Continent 02.

historical_epochs.name: The Clockspring War
historical_epochs.core_rationale: The foundational conflict between Sola, Krono, and Vesper that split the supercontinent into distinct climate and level-band Continents.

world_scars.name: The Kiln-Basin Caldera
world_scars.description: Sola's fallen ceramic shield formed a sheltered, sunlit caldera immune to winter.

world_scars.name: The Uncoiled Mainspring Faultline
world_scars.description: Krono's severed mainspring uncoiled across the eastern plains, carving deep canyon trenches.

world_scars.name: The Inverted Gravity Crater
world_scars.description: Where Vesper's tear struck the northern ocean, gravity inverted and froze the archipelago in time.

starter_town_bindings.spawn_rationale: Located directly inside Sola's unbroken Ceramic Palm where Hearth-Sparks condense gently; zero lethal weather and 100 percent toddler-scaled cottages.

causal_continuity.evidence: Every Primordial God and Clockspring War scar directly spawns a named Continent (continent-01, continent-02, continent-03) and binds the Starter Town arrival.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Establishes the Clockspring Nursery fantasy where 90 to 120 centimeter Star-Kindled children crawl inside shattered Titan reliquaries to relight World-Lanterns.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Locks character height to 0.90 to 1.20 meters (1.05 meter reference) with grass <= 0.35m, bushes <= 0.65m, stair risers <= 0.15m, counters 0.55 to 0.65m, and doorways >= 2.0m.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Connects the sheltered Kiln-Basin starter caldera (Levels 1 to 15) outward to the wind-swept Clockwork Steppe (Levels 15 to 30) and northern Shattered Halo (Levels 30+).

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Marks Vesper the Dream-Eater as intentional mystery with rumor, visual silhouette, and unanswered question while keeping zero deprecated proof-of-concept lore.
